issues.description: Exercise 4.1 template initializes `self.number_of_bits_classical_register` as a string (`"0"`) in `GroverLightsOutPuzzle.__init__`, but `ClassicalRegister()` expects an integer number of bits. This would raise a runtime error when constructing the register and is inconsistent with the solution, which uses an integer.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template to use an integer placeholder: `self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 0` (no quotes), matching the `ClassicalRegister` API and the solution.

issues.description: The problem statement numbers QFT tasks as Exercise 6.1/6.2 (3-qubit QFT) and Exercise 7.1/7.2 (n-qubit QFT), but the corresponding template/solution docstrings label them as Exercise 1.1/1.2 in `ex1_qft.py` and Exercise 2.1/2.2 in `ex2_qft.py`. This numbering mismatch makes it harder for students to map the written tasks to the correct files/methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Align task numbering across artifacts: either update the problem statement to refer to the QFT parts as Exercises 1 and 2 (matching files), or update the docstrings/comments (and any platform task mapping) in `ex1_qft.py` and `ex2_qft.py` to reference Exercises 6 and 7.
